SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS pp.name AS place_name, pp.category_cd AS category_cd, pp.category_group_name, pp.category_name AS category_name, pp.status, pp.sido_code, pp.tel AS phone, pp.full_address AS address_name, pp.road_address AS road_address_name, pp.x_position AS x, pp.y_position AS y, pp.place_url, pp.description, (SELECT bf_fileurl FROM g5_board_file gbf INNER JOIN pet_place_file_mapping ppfm ON gbf.bo_table = 'pet_place' AND gbf.wr_id = ppfm.pfm_id WHERE ppfm.place_id = pp.id LIMIT 1) AS image_url, pp.opening_hours, IFNULL((SELECT CAST(AVG(point) AS signed integer) FROM pet_review WHERE place_id = pp.id), 0) AS point FROM pet_place pp WHERE pp.del_fl = 0 AND pp.id = #{placeId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pet_place WHERE del_fl = 0 AND id = #{placeId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_place ( name, category_cd, category_group_name, category_name, status, tel, sido_code, full_address, road_address, x_position, y_position, place_url, opening_hours, description ) VALUES ( #{placeName}, #{categoryCd}, #{categoryGroupName}, #{categoryName}, #{status}, #{phone}, #{sidoCode}, #{fullAddress}, #{roadAddress}, #{x}, #{y}, #{placeUrl}, #{openingHours}, #{description} );
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_place SET name = #{placeName}, category_cd = #{categoryCd}, category_group_name = #{categoryGroupName}, category_name = #{categoryName}, status = #{status}, tel = #{phone}, sido_code = #{sidoCode}, full_address = #{fullAddress}, road_address = #{roadAddress}, x_position = #{x}, y_position = #{y}, place_url = #{placeUrl}, opening_hours = #{openingHours}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{placeId};
